args.sql_text:
INSERT INTO daily_order_kpis (snapshot_date, status, currency, order_count, total_cents)
SELECT DATE(UTC_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS snapshot_date,
       status,
       currency,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       SUM(total_cents) AS total_cents
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= (UTC_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND placed_at < UTC_DATE()
GROUP BY status, currency;

SELECT snapshot_date, status, currency, order_count, total_cents
FROM daily_order_kpis
WHERE snapshot_date = DATE(UTC_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY status, currency
LIMIT 200;
